speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV). The clinical presentation of sudden, brief vertigo lasting less than a minute (the patient reported 3 minutes, which is slightly atypical but fits the otherwise benign profile) with normal imaging, audiometry, and vascular studies, alongside the absence of migraine history or inflammatory markers, strongly supports a diagnosis of displaced otoconia in the semicircular canals.
